source.title: Integral equation for source of ionization in hollow cathode

claims.text: A pendulum effect could be switched on or off, with consideration for the anode to be transparent or not for fast ionizing electrons.

claims.text: On the basis of a stationary kinetic equation for ionizing electrons an integral equation for a source of ionization is derived.

claims.text: To simulate the influence of pendulum effect in hollow cathode configuration on a current-voltage characteristic it is proposed to consider a plane glow discharge in onedimensional space configuration with two plane parallel cathodes and one plane anode in the middle.
